nodes.text: The Human Metapneumovirus (HPMV) is spreading, and it's important to understand how. HPMV is a respiratory virus that can cause mild to severe symptoms, especially in young children, older adults, and people with weakened immune systems. #HPMVinfo https://t.co/y8lmobP1Pi

nodes.author: shrutishelke_
nodes.text:
HPMV spreads through close contact with infected people. This can happen through:

Coughing or sneezing
Touching contaminated surfaces
Direct contact, like kissing or shaking hands #HPMVspread

nodes.author: shrutishelke_
nodes.text:
To protect yourself and others:

Wash your hands frequently with soap and water
Avoid touching your face with unwashed hands

Cover your coughs and sneezes 1

nodes.author: shrutishelke_
nodes.text:
Symptoms of HPMV can include:

Fever
Cough
Runny nose
Sore throat
Wheezing
Shortness of breath #HPMVsymptoms
5/5

nodes.author: shrutishelke_
nodes.text: If you're concerned about HPMV, talk to your doctor. There is no specific treatment for HPMV, but most people recover on their own. In severe cases, hospitalization may be necessary. Stay informed and stay safe! #HPMVaware
